title: Oregon Guard medevac trains with wildfire crews
description: Capt. Daniel Russell, a platoon leader with Golf Company, 1-189th Aviation Battalion, Oregon Army National Guard, talks about his unit's training with multiple firefighting agencies in preparation for the 2018 fire season. The air crew from Golf Company practiced being directed to targets by firefighter crews on the ground and dropping water with a 530-gallon Bambi bucket suspended from their HH-60M Black Hawk helicopter. (Video by Staff Sgt. Zachary Holden, Oregon Military Department Public Affairs)
keywords: wild fire, Bambi Bucket, helicopter, medevac, Oregon National Guard, army, aviation, firefighter
